Renew

How's it going? It's been nearly two months since I've last posted. I don't really have much to talk about here, but I do like keeping this somewhat up to date. Here's how things are going at the moment.

  • Went to a concert with my best friend, got to hear some really cool bands. If you like nu-metal, definitely check out a band called Mulch. Black Heart Society was also *really* good.
  • Work has been busier than ever. Hopefully as the holiday season starts to pick up, things will slow down soon. I hope I don't eat those words.
  • We had a massive oak tree removed from our backyard (I'll put a picture below). It was sad to see it go, but according to the arborist, it was definitely in the process of dying and was becoming a danger to not only our house, but also our neighbors.
  • Got to visit my parents and brother and see my niece and nephew. It was a good time, although as is often the case, way too short.
  • Reading Children of Time, about 70% through with this. This book did NOT go where I thought it would but I've been having to force myself to put it down so I can sleep, it's so good.

Here's the tree before and after, plus the pile of wood chippings left behind. It's something alright.
